description: Source code for upload logs functionality, including log upload checks, configuration retrieval, and process management.

methods.description: Checks if specific files exist to determine if Xpki MTLS log upload is enabled.

methods.description: Checks RFC parameter to determine if log upload before deep sleep is enabled.

methods.name: getUploadLogParameters

methods.description: Starts asynchronous log upload process by forking a new process.
